alerts.title: Viral load monitoring interval should be checked against DTG guideline
alerts.message: Guidelines state that patients on two NRTIs plus DTG should have viral load checked every 6 months, and that 12-monthly testing may be used only if VL is below 50 copies/mL for over 1 year with reliable adherence. The patient's most recent viral load was 40 copies/mL on 2025-10-01 (113 days before the visit), which is below 50 copies/mL, and adherence is reported as good. The last test is recent, so the 6-month interval is not yet overdue, but the clinician's plan does not document the next viral load due date.

evidence.recommended_action: Document the next viral load due date (6 months from 2025-10-01, or 12 months if criteria for extended interval are met) in the plan.
